**Reasoning**: The test image shows a discrete, elongated brown canker on a mid-stem internode with no collapse or leaf symptoms visible. This is the classic presentation of Alternaria stem canker (*Alternaria alternata* f. sp. *lycopersici*). The brown, elongated, somewhat sunken lesion fits this class far better than any other candidate examined.
